messages:
Sam (PM): Quick PRD intake — customer tenant 'AvaHealth' is seeing degraded conversational quality when traffic is routed to our quantized-v2 model variants. Problem statement: after 3–4 turns the assistant starts dropping earlier context and hallucinating slot values. This is causing failed flows in the booking path. Need to capture goals, non-goals, acceptance criteria, and edge cases so eng can estimate rollout guardrails. @Jin can you triage whether this is batching/KV eviction or quantization artifact?

Jin (Eng): Can confirm some logs look like repeated KV misses around 2–3k token mark. Suspect two things: (1) quantized kernel differences under long KV reuse, (2) our streaming cache eviction policy is too aggressive for long convo windows. I'll gather a sample trace.

Priya (Design): From UX perspective we should avoid abrupt content loss. Non-goal: we won't change the assistant flow in this sprint. Goal: define fallback UX (re-summarize prompt or explicit "context trimmed" banner) + automated detection so we surface to user before failure.

Alex (SRE): Operational goals: keep p95 latency under 700ms for interactive flows and per-tenant error-rate <0.5% for core booking intents after rollout. Need observability: per-route KV-hit-rate, per-request token-count histogram, and per-model regression alert. Also add a canary rollout window (1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automatic rollback on quality regression.

Leo (ML): Propose evaluation harness: 200 curated multi-turn dialogs across booking and clarification flows. Metric: semantic similarity vs baseline fp16 using BERTScore F1 >= 0.92 OR intent classification match >= 98%. Also measure slot-filling accuracy >= 99% for critical fields. Example eval command:```bash
python eval/run_diff_eval.py --baseline model=redwood/fp16 --candidate model=redwood/quant-v2 --suite=ava_booking_200 --metric=bertscore
```Edge cases: long system prompts (>1024 tokens), tool-calling turns, embedded JSON structured responses, and truncated embeddings impacting rerankers.

Sam (PM): Non-goals (explicit): no model re-training, no infra hardware changes, and no changes to customer SDKs. Success metrics summary: quality regression <= 1% absolute vs baseline on booking suite; slot accuracy drop <= 0.5%; latency p95 <= 700ms. If any of those fail at canary -> automatic rollback.

Jin (Eng): For scope: estimate 3 dev-weeks to add KV diagnostics + automated eviction policy experiment, 2 dev-weeks to add canary rollout automation, 1 week to wire metric alerts. Need help from Leo on eval harness and from Priya on UX copy for "context trimmed".

Priya (Design): I'll draft two tiny UX flows (banner + re-summarize CTA) and supply copy + mock. ETA: 3 working days.

Sam (PM): OK I'll draft the PRD with these sections: problem, customer impact, goals & non-goals, success metrics, rollout plan, and acceptance tests. Will link here when ready. Action items: Jin -> sample traces by EOD, Leo -> first eval run by Thu, Priya -> mocks in 3 days.

qa-bot: Reminder: please add a short test matrix to the PRD and tag qa@redwood for integration tests.

Alex (SRE): +1 to the plan. Also suggest adding a short-lived debug flag to route specific tenant traffic to verbose logging for 24h during canary.

Sam (PM): Thanks — will include debug flag and observability checklist. Draft PRD link: https://redwood.internal/prds/scope-garden-paths-1719999999 (draft, internal). :thumbsup:
